description: Source Insight 4 style Context and Relation windows for VS Code with call trees, configurable depth, callers/callees, locks, and symbol-only graph nodes.

description: Drive the Claude Code running on your UltraTether Hub from VSCode — the same live sessions as your phone.

title: Conditional Call Flow
description: Conditional inter-procedural call graph: see which function calls which, and under what condition.

title: .NET Resources Structure Viewer
description: Xem cấu trúc nhị phân của file .NET .resources (ResourceReader V1/V2, DeserializingResourceReader): header, bảng type, name/data section, giá trị, ảnh và hex dump.
